generation.prompt: Create one production-ready 2D environmental sprite for the game Aliens: Tantalus Frontier, AVP (2004) pyramid DLC, using the attached photograph of an actual film-production ritual wall panel as the sole geometric reference. Isolate ONLY this tall rectangular carved panel, no floor, no pedestal, no background. Orthographic FRONT view, completely visible, centered with a small clear transparent margin, tall portrait aspect. Preserve the exact overall panel proportions (about 1:2), the arrangement and relative sizes of all the depicted figures, horizontal glyph bands, carved linear motifs, round sun medallion near the upper part, standing figure at the right, seated central figure, feet and lower relief as shown. Preserve the sculpted shallow bas-relief rather than creating living characters. Faithfully follow the pictured shapes and wear without inventing readable letters, decorative marks or a different scene. Use the same weathered charcoal-gray, gray-stone highlights and muted rusty brown coloration, with consistent subtle upper-left illumination for a dark 2D game; fine sharp detail that remains legible at reduced sprite size, no glossy 3D plastic. Remove only the white photographic background and photographic framing; preserve the outer edges and visible small mounting holes as part of this source representation. Do not reconstruct invisible reverse side or add any new elements. Exactly ONE separate sprite, no sprite sheet, no title, no watermark, no text outside the carving. True transparent alpha background.

observations: Composition générale et silhouette reconnaissables ; aucune traduction des glyphes.
Microreliefs, grains, trous et proportions fines restent à comparer et peuvent différer de la photographie.
Alpha médian non nul = 253 ; des pixels très faiblement opaques débordent la silhouette principale.
Le contenu principal reste à l’intérieur du canevas au seuil alpha>=128.
requiredBeforeRuntime: Nettoyer ou régénérer le détourage sans altérer les motifs attestés.
Comparer les reliefs et proportions avec un plan du film et la photographie du décor.
Valider l’échelle, les ancrages, la lisibilité et l’éclairage en jeu.
